iso_title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
mapping_rationale: Maintaining asset inventories supports the asset management outcome.
impact_rationale: Incomplete inventories can leave important systems unmanaged.

mapping_rationale: Access rules support management and enforcement of permissions.
impact_rationale: Unauthorized access could expose sensitive systems and data.

mapping_rationale: Supplier security requirements support supply chain risk management.
impact_rationale: Supplier failures may disrupt services or expose information.

iso_title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
mapping_rationale: Incident management preparation supports execution of response procedures.
impact_rationale: Poor preparation can delay response and increase damage.

mapping_rationale: Response procedures support coordinated incident management.
impact_rationale: Ineffective response can increase operational and information loss.

mapping_rationale: Readiness planning supports execution of recovery plans.
impact_rationale: Weak continuity readiness can cause prolonged disruption.

iso_title: Information security awareness, education and training
mapping_rationale: Training helps personnel understand cybersecurity responsibilities.
impact_rationale: Low awareness increases exposure to phishing and mistakes.

mapping_rationale: Physical monitoring supports identification of adverse physical events.
impact_rationale: Undetected physical access can compromise assets.

mapping_rationale: Least privilege is central to privileged-access management.
impact_rationale: Misused privileged access can affect critical systems.

mapping_rationale: Secure authentication supports verification of users and systems.
impact_rationale: Weak authentication can enable account compromise.

mapping_rationale: Protection mechanisms help prevent unauthorized or malicious software execution.
impact_rationale: Malware can compromise or disrupt critical systems.

mapping_rationale: Vulnerability identification and validation support risk assessment.
Configuration practices support secure platform operation.
Backups support protection and recoverability of information.
impact_rationale: Failed backups can prevent recovery of critical information.

mapping_rationale: Log monitoring supports observation of adverse activity.
impact_rationale: Missing logs can impair detection and investigation.

mapping_rationale: Monitoring activity supports detection of adverse events.
impact_rationale: Weak monitoring can delay threat identification.

mapping_rationale: Network resilience controls support secure infrastructure operation.
impact_rationale: Network control failure may expose multiple systems.

mapping_rationale: Cryptographic protections support data confidentiality and integrity.
impact_rationale: Weak cryptography can expose sensitive information.

mapping_rationale: Controlled configuration changes support secure platform operation.
impact_rationale: Poor changes can introduce outages and vulnerabilities.
